review.notes: Structure: the three code fences (Algorithm 1 'txt' block and two 'python' listings in Section V-C) are balanced and legitimate printed listings, none swallows headings, tables or images. Droppage: iterative n-gram and token diffs against all 19 physical pages found no dropped prose; full paragraphs were read on pages 1-2 (title/authors/affiliations/contribution footnote), V-B/V-C (algorithm context, FAST+ release), VI-A through VI-F and VII (results, limitation and scaling paragraphs verified verbatim including the '300M action expert', '903M timesteps', '9.1%' and '750ms' values). TABLE I token counts, TABLE II (32 rows) and TABLE III (15 rows) match the PDF text layer as digit multisets; references [1]-[74] match including accented names (Defossez, Aguilar, Waymo page ranges) and the print's own typo 'his task was evaluated' (Appendix C) which is preserved as printed. Remaining PDF-only tokens are log-scale axis labels and panels inside embedded figures (Figs. 4, 10), the arXiv stamp, and citation-number interleaving artifacts of two-column extraction. Visual verification at 300 dpi: physical p.5 Algorithm 1 box and physical p.19 TABLE III rows. The print's 'pi Table Bussing [7]' cell prints pi without a subscript and the OCR cell matches it, so no repair is proposed there.

patches.evidence: 300 dpi crop of the printed Algorithm 1 box on physical p.5: the final line reads 'return action tokens' with a space; the OCR 'txt' code block wrote 'return action_tokens' with an underscore. Only this final line is changed; the rest of the block's sub/superscript linearization is kept as a plain-text equivalent of the stacked indices.

unresolved.evidence: The printed flatten step stacks sub- and superscripts on each C-bar symbol ([Cbar^1_1, Cbar^2_1, ..., Cbar^1_2, ..., Cbar^n_H]); the txt block linearizes each as subscript-then-superscript. Both orders read as the same stacked symbol in the monospace render, so the unchanged spelling is kept.
TABLE III's dataset cell prints 'pi Table Bussing [7]' with no visible subscript on the pi (visually verified at 300 dpi); the OCR cell '$\pi$ Table Bussing [7]' matches the print.
